primary.title: The Waymo World Model: A New Frontier For Autonomous Driving Simulation

second_official.title: Simulate real-world places with Project Genie and Street View
second_official.supports: Google identifies Genie as enabling Waymo road simulation; links directly to Waymo primary. Not evidence for individual weather clips or vehicle physical accuracy.

verification_passes: Read Waymo official blog via web open: date, Genie 3 foundation, language weather control, camera plus lidar, exact cloudy/foggy/rainy/snowy/sunny labels.
Read raw official HTML and matched three source video URLs to exact weather sections; inspected downloaded video frames and ffprobe metadata.
Read second official Google article and verified its Waymo link; independent web search also returned Waymo primary with publication date.
safe_claims: 2026-02-06 Waymo introduced a generative world model built upon Genie 3 for autonomous-driving simulation.
Language control can change time of day and weather; generated multimodal outputs include camera and lidar.
The presented weather footage is official AI-generated simulation, not footage of actual weather trials.
unsupported_claims_to_avoid: Do not describe this as a validated suspension, tire-force, braking-distance, or vehicle-dynamics simulator.
Do not claim our deck runs Waymo model live. It plays a cited excerpt of Waymo public demonstrations.
Do not claim model weights are open, this is free public tooling, or it is available for our team to install.
Do not claim this automatically proves safe real-world behavior.

media.edit: Original Sunny 0–3.2s, 0.8s last-frame hold; Foggy 0–3.2s, 0.8s hold; Rainy 0–3.2s, 0.8s hold. Scaled uniformly from 2400x1506 to 1200x754, padded with labels above/below, concatenated. No synthesized or replaced scene content, no footage crop, original speed retained. Web delivery copy re-encoded at 840×596, H.264 CRF34, unchanged 12-second sequence and playback speed.
media.credit: Waymo — The Waymo World Model (2026.02.06), official public demonstration. Korean labels and excerpt assembly for explanatory presentation.
media.rights: Source footage remains Waymo content. No open-license or ownership claim. Short attributed demonstration excerpts are included to discuss the published research; link to full original source.

recommended_slide.title: 같은 도로에, 다른 날씨를 넣어봅니다
recommended_slide.caption: Waymo 공개 시뮬레이션 · 2026.02.06
recommended_slide.caveat: 영상·센서 상황 생성 사례입니다. 차량의 물리 성능을 검증한 결과는 아닙니다.
recommended_slide.speaker_notes: 게임을 연결하면 하나의 공간처럼 보이게 만들 수 있었습니다. 그럼 이런 가상 환경을 차량 시험에 쓰면 어떨까요? 지금 보시는 건 Waymo가 공개한 시뮬레이션입니다. 같은 도로에 맑은 날씨, 안개, 비를 넣고, 카메라 영상뿐 아니라 아래쪽의 라이다 데이터도 함께 만듭니다. 실제 시험에서 만나기 어려운 조건을 먼저 만들어볼 수 있다는 점이 핵심입니다. 다만 여기서 확인할 수 있는 것은 주행 상황을 생성하는 기술입니다. 댐퍼나 타이어의 물리 성능까지 검증됐다는 뜻은 아닙니다. 우리 업무에서는 시험 상황을 다양하게 만드는 아이디어로 볼 수 있겠습니다.
